technique_name: Explain why mentorship is important for professional development.
description: Mentorship is a critical component of professional development as it provides mentees with valuable advice and insight from an experienced and knowledgeable person. Mentors help mentees to understand what success looks like in their respective field and can provide new perspectives on how to tackle challenging tasks.
